our_summary1 <-

HCPC analysis for all NESE females
```{r}

data.iso <- readRDS("../data/data_iso.rds")

col4PCA <- c('TOPPID','Trip','Sex','ProcedureYear','d13C',	'd15N', 
             'MaxLat_degrees','MinLon_degrees','MedianDistToContShelf_km',	
             'SdDistContShelf_km','MesoEcoProportionShelf',	
             'MesoEcoProportionCAC','MesoEcoProportionSubArcticPac',	
             'MesoEcoProportionNorthCPac','Mean_Depth_m', 'Mean_Depth_sd',
             'Mean_Duration_sec', 'Mean_Duration_sd', 'Pct_TransitDives', 
             'Pct_ForagingDives', 'Pct_DriftDives', 'Pct_BenthicDives',	
             'PctTripDiving', 'DeepDayForageDivesMedian_m', 
             'DeepNightForageDivesMedian_m') 


PCAdata <- data.iso[,col4PCA] # 306 cases  
PCAdata$DeepDayForageDivesMedian_m <- PCAdata$DeepDayForageDivesMedian_m *-1
PCAdata$DeepNightForageDivesMedian_m <- PCAdata$DeepNightForageDivesMedian_m *-1
PCAdata$ProcedureYear <- as.factor(PCAdata$ProcedureYear)
f.PCAdata <- dplyr::filter(PCAdata, Sex == "Female") # Extract the data just for females , 180 females


#First exploratory PCA with all data, including Isotopes
f.PCAdata.1 <- na.omit(f.PCAdata)
row.names(f.PCAdata.1) <- f.PCAdata.1$TOPPID
#f.PCAdata.1[1] <- NULL

# Correlation Matrix plot
cor.data <- abs(cor(f.PCAdata.1[c(5:25)]))
cor.colours <- dmat.color(cor.data)
cor.ordered <- order.single(cor(f.PCAdata.1[c(5:25)]))
cpairs(f.PCAdata.1[c(5:25)], panel.colors = cor.colours, gap =.5)

#PCA
PCA.f.1 <- prcomp(f.PCAdata.1[c(5:25)], center = TRUE, scale = TRUE)
summary(PCA.f.1)

# Plot the PCs to look at variance explained
pdf("../figures/PCAVariance_All.pdf")
screeplot(PCA.f.1, type = "l", npcs = 12, main = "Screeplot of the first 12 PCs")
abline(h = 1, col="red", lty=5)
legend("topright", legend=c("Eigenvalue = 1"),
       col=c("red"), lty=5, cex=0.6)
dev.off()

screeplot(PCA.f.1, type = "l", npcs = 12, main = "Screeplot of the first 12 PCs")
abline(h = 1, col="red", lty=5)
legend("topright", legend=c("Eigenvalue = 1"),
       col=c("red"), lty=5, cex=0.6)

# Cumulative proportion
cumpro <- cumsum(PCA.f.1$sdev^2 / sum(PCA.f.1$sdev^2))
pdf("../figures/PCACumumlativeVariance_All.pdf")
plot(cumpro[0:12], xlab = "PC #", ylab = "Amount of explained variance", main = "Cumulative variance plot")
abline(v = 6, col="blue", lty=5)
abline(h = 0.78030 , col="blue", lty=5) # Cumulative variance explained by the 10 PCs
legend("topleft", legend=c("Cut-off @ PC 7"),
       col=c("blue"), lty=5, cex=0.6)
dev.off()

plot(cumpro[0:12], xlab = "PC #", ylab = "Amount of explained variance", main = "Cumulative variance plot")
abline(v = 6, col="blue", lty=5)
abline(h = 0.78030 , col="blue", lty=5) # Cumulative variance explained by the 10 PCs
legend("topleft", legend=c("Cut-off @ PC 7"),
       col=c("blue"), lty=5, cex=0.6)

# Check the loadings and scores
pdf("../figures/PCAScores_Trip_All.pdf")
autoplot(PCA.f.1, data = f.PCAdata.1, colour = 'Trip', loadings = TRUE, 
         loadings.colour = 'blue',loadings.label = TRUE, loadings.label.size = 3, main = "Trip")
dev.off()

autoplot(PCA.f.1, data = f.PCAdata.1, colour = 'Trip', loadings = TRUE, 
         loadings.colour = 'blue',loadings.label = TRUE, loadings.label.size = 3, main = "Trip")

# Check the loadings and scores
pdf("../figures/PCAScores_Year_All.pdf")
autoplot(PCA.f.1, data = f.PCAdata.1, colour = 'ProcedureYear', loadings = TRUE, 
         loadings.colour = 'blue',loadings.label = TRUE, loadings.label.size = 3, main = "Year")
dev.off()

autoplot(PCA.f.1, data = f.PCAdata.1, colour = 'ProcedureYear', loadings = TRUE, 
         loadings.colour = 'blue',loadings.label = TRUE, loadings.label.size = 3, main = "Year")

# Fancy plot with ellipses
f <- fviz_pca_ind(PCA.f.1, geom.ind = "point", pointshape = 21, 
             pointsize = 2, 
             fill.ind = f.PCAdata.1$Trip, 
             col.ind = "black", 
             palette = "simpsons", 
             addEllipses = TRUE,
             label = "var",
             col.var = "black",
             repel = TRUE,
             legend.title = "Trip") +
  ggtitle("2D PCA-plot from trip variables") +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5))
print(f)
ggsave(filename = "../figures/PCAGroups_Season.pdf",
       plot = f,
       device = cairo_pdf)

# HCPC with 6 PCs
fPCAhc <- scale(f.PCAdata.1[c(5:25)])
res.pca.f.1 <- PCA(fPCAhc, ncp = 6, graph = FALSE)

# Extract the loadings
loadings.pca.f.1= sweep(res.pca.f.1$var$coord,2,sqrt(res.pca.f.1$eig[1:ncol(res.pca.f.1$var$coord),1]),FUN="/")
 
# Rotate the loadings 
loadings.pca.f.1 <- varimax(loadings.pca.f.1)$loadings

# Replace the values using the rotated
res.pca.f.1$var$coord <- loadings.pca.f.1

# Extract the data to save
pca.var <- get_pca(res.pca.f.1, element = c("var", "ind"))
coord <- pca.var[["coord"]]
contrib <- pca.var[["contrib"]]

write.csv(coord,'../results/PCAcoord_All.csv')
write.csv(contrib,'../results/PCAcontrib_All.csv')


# Compute hierarchical clustering on principal components
res.hcpc.1 <- HCPC(res.pca.f.1, metric = "euclidean", method = "ward", graph = FALSE)

plot(res.hcpc.1) # 5 clusters

# Check that k is right
ind.PCA <- get_pca_ind(res.pca.f.1)
ind.PCA <- data.frame(ind.PCA$coord[,1:6])
ind.PCA <- tibble::rownames_to_column(ind.PCA, "AnimalID")
col2keep <- colnames(ind.PCA)
col2keep <- c("Dim.1","Dim.2","Dim.3","Dim.4","Dim.5", "Dim.6")
ind.PCA <- ind.PCA[,col2keep]

res.nbclust <- NbClust(ind.PCA, distance = "euclidean",
                       min.nc = 2, max.nc = 15, 
                       method = "ward.D", index ="all")

# Agree that 10 is the correct number of clusters
# Compute hierarchical clustering on principal components
res.hcpc.1 <- HCPC(res.pca.f.1,
                      nb.clust = 10,
                      metric = "euclidean", 
                      method = "ward", 
                      graph = FALSE)

# Plot
f <- fviz_dend(res.hcpc.1, 
          cex = 0.7,                     # Label size
          palette = "jco",               # Color palette see ?ggpubr::ggpar
          rect = TRUE, rect_fill = TRUE, # Add rectangle around groups
          rect_border = "jco",           # Rectangle color
          labels_track_height = 0.8,      # Augment the room for labels
          main = "Cluster analysis for all females"
                    )
print(f)
ggsave(filename = "../figures/PCA_HCPC_Season.pdf",
       plot = f,
       device = cairo_pdf)


# Bi-space
f <- fviz_cluster(res.hcpc.1,
             repel = TRUE,            # Avoid label overlapping
             show.clust.cent = TRUE, # Show cluster centers
             palette = "jco",         # Color palette see ?ggpubr::ggpar
             ggtheme = theme_minimal(),
             main = "Factor map"
             )

print(f)
ggsave(filename = "../figures/PCA_HCPC2D_Season.pdf",
       plot = f,
       device = cairo_pdf)


# Summary table
sum.whole <- summary_table(f.PCAdata.1, our_summary1)
sum.whole

f.PCAdata.1$clusterAll <- paste('Cluster',res.hcpc.1$data.clust$clust)
write.csv(f.PCAdata.1,'../results/All_Clusters.csv')


saveRDS(f.PCAdata.1, file = '../data/f.PCAdata.1.rds')

```
